title: YOUR LOVE IS TO ME

lines.text: Your love is to me like an overflowing stream (2)
Lord I need Your love, yes I need your love,
I need Your love to make it through.
Your Word is to me, like a lamp unto my feet,
Your Word is to me, like a lamp unto my path,
Lord we need Your Word, yes we need Your Word,
We need Your Word to make it through.
